record.title: Rumichaca indigenous vehicle blockade over destroyed community bridges, February 2025
record.scope: Vehicle passage over Rumichaca international bridge; humanitarian pedestrian windows excluded
record.direction: Vehicle movement between both countries obstructed.
record.movement: Private vehicles, public transport and freight.
record.exceptions: Humanitarian pedestrian passage was opened intermittently; this is a vehicle-closure record.
record.imposing_authority: Protesting Pastos, Quillasingas and Awá communities
record.enforcement: Communities physically occupied the bridge approach; government representatives negotiated access.
record.consequences: Vehicle disruption and dialogue culminating in an agreement; no loss estimate adopted.
record.relationship: Distinct from Ecuador’s February 8 election entry ban (AM042); non-state blockade began later.
record.status_observation: Status limited to dated evidence; no claim of present closure.
record.official_rationale: Protesters demanded restoration of community bridges and dialogue over their destruction.
record.context: Ecuadorian forces had destroyed cross-border pedestrian bridges on February 20, citing illicit use; affected communities disputed the action.
record.uncertainty: Explicit February 26–28 dates are stronger than El Tiempo’s inconsistent 80-hour summary. Several pages have changed or inconsistent publication metadata; dates are taken from event-specific body text. Exact hour duration is not established.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty. February 26 to 28, with pedestrian windows. Exact continuous interval withheld because published hour totals conflict.
